zh: 这款新手机搭载了自研芯片，性能提升了百分之三十。
en: The new phone is powered by a self-developed chip, thirty percent faster than before.

zh: 人工智能正在改变我们工作和学习的方式。
en: Artificial intelligence is changing the way we work and learn.

zh: 大模型已经能写代码、翻译文档，还会总结会议纪要。
en: Large AI models can now write code, translate documents, and even summarize meetings.

zh: 芯片制造依赖光刻机，这是全球技术竞争的焦点。
en: Chipmaking depends on lithography machines, the focal point of global tech competition.

zh: 火箭成功回收，标志着可重复使用航天器迈出关键一步。
en: The rocket's successful recovery marks a key step toward reusable spacecraft.

zh: 电动车充电十分钟就能跑四百公里，续航焦虑大大缓解。
en: An electric car can add four hundred kilometers of range in ten minutes of charging, easing range anxiety.

zh: 数据中心耗电量巨大，散热成了运营商最头疼的问题。
en: Data centers use huge amounts of electricity, and cooling is a constant headache for operators.

zh: 这家公司把自动驾驶出租车开进了三座大城市。
en: The company has launched robotaxis in three major cities.

zh: 数字人民币试点扩大，已有两千万用户开通钱包。
en: The digital yuan pilot has expanded, with twenty million users opening e-wallets.

zh: 风电和光伏装机容量再创新高，绿电比例稳步提升。
en: Wind and solar capacity has hit a new high, raising the share of green electricity.

zh: 卫星互联网开始商用，偏远山区也能高速上网。
en: Satellite internet has gone commercial, bringing high-speed access to remote mountain areas.

zh: 研究团队开发了可降解的生物芯片，用于疾病早期筛查。
en: The research team developed biodegradable biochips for early disease screening.

zh: 开源社区的力量不容小觑，全球开发者一起打磨这个系统。
en: Never underestimate open-source communities; developers worldwide refine the system together.

zh: 智能音箱不仅能放音乐，还能控制家里的灯光和空调。
en: Smart speakers do more than play music; they can control the lights and air conditioning too.

zh: 工厂引入机器人后，良品率提高了，工人转型去做设备维护。
en: Since robots joined the factory, yield rates have risen and workers have moved to equipment maintenance.

zh: 量子计算机在特定任务上的速度已远超传统超算。
en: Quantum computers already outperform traditional supercomputers on certain tasks.

zh: 手机厂商竞相布局折叠屏，铰链技术不断突破。
en: Phone makers are racing into foldable screens, and hinge technology keeps improving.

zh: 网络安全形势严峻，企业在安全防护上的投入持续增加。
en: With cybersecurity threats rising, companies keep increasing their spending on protection.

zh: 这款应用用人工智能实时翻译语音，支持四十多种语言。
en: This app translates speech in real time with AI, supporting over forty languages.

zh: 新一代北斗系统定位精度更高，服务全球一百多个国家和地区。
en: The next-generation BeiDou system offers higher positioning accuracy, serving more than a hundred countries and regions.
